The role is highly visible and there are opportunities for career growth through demonstrated achievement. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the rang

jobs.title: Team Lead, Ground Operations (3rd Shift)
jobs.location_raw: Phoenix, AZ · Dallas, TX · Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description_text: As the Team Lead for Ground Operations (3rd Shift), you will drive operational excellence by leading overnight fleet maintenance, rework, and mission readiness activities. Service efficiency and comprehensive fleet preparedness are key drivers of our success, making this role critical to ensuring that vehicle maintenance, reworks, and fleet readiness activities are optimized overnight during low-demand periods. You will be responsible for the holistic readiness of our vehicle fleet, ensuring maximum fleet uptime and vehicle availability for daytime operations. In this technical leadership role, you will ensure vehicles are configured, maintained, and prepared for service, while shaping a positive workshop and depot culture. You will lead a team of skilled vehicle technicians and readiness and response associates on the overnight shift. By optimizing workflows and taking ownership of mission-critical readiness targets, you will act as a strategic partner to cross-functional teams, translating high-level operational goals into actionable plans for your 3rd-shift crew. Shift : Friday - Tuesday, 10pm - 6am Base Salary Range There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Readiness & Response
jobs.description_text: As a Team Lead for Readiness and Response within Zoox’s Fleet Operations organization, you are at the forefront of the autonomous mobility revolution. You will be a key leader in our expansion into new markets, responsible for the end-to-end operational integrity of the Zoox Robotaxi and Mapping Vehicle Fleet. This role unifies the technical preparation of our vehicles (Readiness) with high-level oversight of live field incidents (Response), ensuring every Zoox vehicle is "service ready" and every mission is supported with operational excellence. Your leadership will bridge the gap between structured depot workflows and the dynamic environment of real-time fleet response. Rather than performing hands-on technical tasks, you will drive strategy and performance by managing a hybrid workforce of Full-Time Shift Leads and contingent associates. Serving as the primary on-site escalation path for critical field incidents and holding third-party recovery partners accountable, you will directly impact Zoox’s fleet availability, safety standards, and our ability to deliver a seamless experience to our riders. Shift: 1st Shift, 7am - 4pm, Tuesday - Saturday Travel Requirements: less than 20% Base Salary Range There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Vehicle Technicians
jobs.description_text: As the Team Lead for Base Operations, you will move beyond day-to-day fleet maintenance to own and evolve the operational backbone of Zoox’s Base Operations function. This role drives operational excellence, standardization, and scale-readiness across workshop operations while ensuring the holistic readiness, safety, and strategic deployment of Zoox’s Robotaxi vehicle fleet. You will serve as a people leader, operational owner, and change driver, accountable for implementing and improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), enforcing EH&S and 5S standards, and building a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. In partnership with cross-functional stakeholders, you will translate company-level objectives and future growth plans into actionable, scalable execution models for your team.

jobs.title: Vehicle Program Analyst
jobs.description_text: Zoox is developing autonomous driving from the ground up, including a unique vehicle tailored for autonomous driving. The Vehicle Program team works cross-functionally to ensure this groundbreaking vehicle is delivered on time, on budget, and to a very high quality standard. The Program Analyst will help run one or more Vehicle Programs by analyzing, tracking, and executing program plans, coordinating cross-functional work, and driving follow-through on action plans toward pre-set targets and program phases.

jobs.title: Control Systems Architect – IFE
jobs.description_text: As a Control Systems Architect on our Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) program, you will define the control system architecture for Xcimer’s fusion power plant and carry it from concept through detailed design. You will work directly with the program’s control systems director as the hands-on engineering counterpart, turning plant-level control philosophy into architecture, interface definitions, and design baselines. You will also contribute as a working controls engineer within the plant’s other major systems such as laser, fusion chamber, fuel processing, and power conversion, as their control and instrumentation designs mature. Working within the Electrical & Control Systems Engineering department, you will exercise independent judgment on complex, first-of-a-kind problems, with work reviewed against program objectives. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Control Systems Engineer II - Applied Science
jobs.description_text: As a Control Systems Engineer II in our Applied Science group, you will help deliver the control, data acquisition, timing, and interlock systems for Xcimer’s directed energy program, which is developing multi-kilojoule-class pulsed lasers for air defense applications. Applied Science delivers the test and measurement systems used to validate advanced hardware and first of its kind science. Working within the Control Systems Engineering department, you will own well-scoped software and integration tasks with day-to-day independence, receiving general direction on new assignments and review of your work from senior engineers, and you will spend real time on the test floor bringing hardware to life. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science
jobs.description_text: As a Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science, you will own the controls system of a major development program, starting with one of our large, multi-subsystem laser test facilities. Our Applied Science group delivers control systems that integrate advanced hardware to demonstrate cutting-edge science, and in this role you will design, implement, verify, and commission the control, data acquisition, and interlock systems that enable scientific experimentation. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with coordination responsibility: you will plan and assign sprint work to other team members, deliver software releases on schedule, work directly with system operators, and coordinate controls activities with the other engineering teams on the program. We are looking for an engineer who brings strong diagnostic thinking, test stand experience, and demonstrable software capability, along with the organization to keep a multi-team controls effort on track.

jobs.title: Cryophysicist
jobs.description_text: We are welcoming applicants for a Cryophysicist position on Xcimer’s Fill and Injection Station Team. The successful candidate will join a growing group of engineers and scientists aimed at developing the processes and technologies to build a first of its kind Inertial Fusion Energy fueling station for Xcimer’s fusion reactor plant. In this role, you will lead the experimental and theoretical design, characterization, and optimization of physical systems operating at ultra-low temperatures. You will manage relations and work closely with collaborators from national labs and universities to drive research objectives that will critically impact future system design and architecture. This is an entry- to mid-level role focused on experimental and theoretical R&D.

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Target Design
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy is advancing Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) by combining decades of scientific progress with a breakthrough laser architecture designed for practical and scalable fusion power. Our mission is to deploy commercial fusion plants quickly enough to accelerate global decarbonization, and also reduc the cost of electricity. Backed by leading investors, Xcimer brings together experts in laser physics, fusion science, and advanced manufacturing with a proven history of rapid execution. With a uniquely positioned team and technology, we are urgently working to deliver clean, abundant fusion energy with the speed to address climate change. Please join us in building a future powered by laser driven inertial confinement fusion (ICF). As the Director of Integrated Target Design at Xcimer, you will lead the interdisciplinary group of scientists and engineers that optimize all aspects of target physics for our new laser architecture. Your main responsibilities will be to guide efforts in advanced simulations and experiments, as well as the recruitment, mentoring, and development of the team. As a technical expert, you will provide day-to-day guidance to your team and participate in cross-function discussions across ICF disciplines. In close partnership with the program leads, you will translate high-level priorities and objectives into actionable plans, and build the culture and collaborations needed to reach the highest possible levels of fusion performance. At Xcimer, you can

jobs.title: Director, Licensing & Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description_text: As the Director, Licensing & Regulatory Affairs, you will apply your skills to build and lead the Operations department that secures and maintains every license, permit, and regulatory approval Xcimer needs to site, build, and operate its facilities. You will own regulatory strategy, agency relationships, and the end-to-end management of license and permit applications, and you will run the compliance obligations system that keeps Xcimer in good standing once approvals are granted. You will partner closely with Engineering, which owns the technical and safety analyses that underpin our applications; your team makes sure that work becomes complete, on-time, well-received submittals and durable regulatory commitments. We are looking for our leaders to apply their expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Integration
jobs.description_text: As an Electrical Engineer on our Integration team, you will turn the control system’s wiring and interconnect definitions into complete, buildable electrical design packages and carry them through fabrication, checkout, and handoff with the Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls (E&IC) technician team, initially in support of Xcimer’s directed energy program, which is developing multi-kilojoule-class pulsed lasers for air defense applications. Working within the Electrical Engineering department, you will own design packages from requirements through as-built, working independently on problems of diverse scope with review at key design milestones. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description_text: As an Embedded Engineer , you will apply your skills to the design, bring-up, and integration of custom electronics and the firmware that runs on them, for systems that sense, time, control, and protect Xcimer’s laser and pulsed power systems, initially in support of Xcimer’s directed energy program, which is developing multi-kilojoule-class pulsed lasers for air defense applications. Working within the Electrical Engineering department, you will own boards and their firmware from requirements through fabrication, bring-up, test, and deployment, working independently on problems of diverse scope with review at key design milestones. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Fluid, Vacuum & Cryogenic Systems Operations Lead
jobs.description_text: As the Fluids, Vacuum, and Cryogenic Operations Lead for our superlasers, you will own, and be accountable for, the proper operation of our superlaser fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems hardware. You and the other operations leads will receive requested experiments from the Xcimer science team and you will use your technical and operational expertise in fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems to develop the operations schedule for experiments, maintenance, and upgrades on these systems. You will lead engineers and technicians in completing this work – ensuring the fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems function when needed for tests. You will also lead post-experiment data reviews to confirm proper system function and determine if additional system work is needed ahead of the next experiments. You will assist with troubleshooting anomalies in the superlasers’ fluids, vacuum, and cryogenic systems. You will also disposition non-conformances and develop operational infrastructure related to the fluids, vaccum, and cryogenic systems such as: operating limits, operating procedures, preventative maintenance requirements, etc. During work on your systems, you will lead hands-on work, helping with the work and leading technicians and other engineers to successfully execute.

jobs.title: Head of PMO
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy is scaling from a single program into a diversified enterprise portfolio, anchored by our Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) program — which represents the large majority of our work — and a growing Defense program with its own risk and access profile. The Head of PMO owns the vision, mandate, and operating model for Xcimer's enterprise Program Management Office: the governance, standards, tools, and talent that let every program, current and future, plan and deliver with discipline, without becoming the bottleneck to speed. This is a hub-and-spoke model. The Head of PMO has direct accountability for the enterprise Hub — its governance, standards, tools, reporting, and staff — and a dotted-line coordination relationship with the program managers embedded in Fusion and Defense (the spokes). The Program Leads for Fusion and Defense continue to own their programs end to end and report to the Executives; the PMO's job is to make sure they, and every future program, are supported by a common, high-quality practice rather than each reinventing one. You build trust quickly and create alignment across program leaders, functional leaders, and the Executive, even when their priorities and operating rhythms differ. You know how to introduce governance and standards in a way that improves speed, clarity, and accountability — not process for its own sake. You bring a relentless focus on execution quality: every initiative in the portfolio has clear ownership, practical milestones,

jobs.title: IFE Program Director
jobs.description_text: This role is responsible for the overall program scope, technical integration, schedule, budget, risk management, and delivery of Xcimer’s IFE Program. The IFE Program Director coordinates multidisciplinary teams spanning fusion physics, targets, laser, chamber, fuel cycle, controls, infrastructure, and other support subsystems to ensure that individual workstreams converge into a coherent, achievable design and development roadmap. Working closely with company leadership and department directors, the Program Director establishes program priorities, allocates resources, resolves cross-functional issues, and drives timely, evidence-based decisions. The successful candidate combines technical understanding of fusion energy systems with demonstrated leadership in complex, multidisciplinary technology development programs and the ability to translate ambitious technical objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

jobs.title: Lab Manager, Materials & Process Engineering
jobs.description_text: The Materials & Process Engineering (M&P) Department is developing several new laboratory capabilities critical to Xcimer's mission, including an analytical lab, a wet chemistry and metallography lab, and advanced molten-salt research facilities. We are seeking an experienced Lab Manager to lead the design, build-out, commissioning, and operation of these shared lab assets. This role is ideal for a technically strong, hands-on laboratory operations professional with experience establishing laboratory infrastructure in industrial environments, implementing safe and efficient operations, and supporting multidisciplinary R&D teams. Operating within Xcimer's matrix organization, you will work closely with engineering, science, facilities, EHS, and external partners to develop and manage laboratory capabilities that support multiple programs across the company. You will play a key role in enabling world-class research and development by ensuring laboratory facilities are safe, reliable, scalable, and aligned with evolving technical priorities.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician, Capacitor Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: As a Maintenance Technician, you will apply your skills to keep the wound film capacitor line at our Tucson, Arizona facility running safely and reliably — the winders, vacuum drying and impregnation systems, ovens, and test equipment that build the capacitors behind Xcimer's pulsed-power laser drivers. We are looking for our technicians to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Manager of Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: As Manager of Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls (EI&C) Manufacturing, you will apply your skills leading a team of engineers and technicians in Manufacturing and integrating cutting edge electrical, instrumentation, and controls hardware for our large laser systems. You will be a player-coach who leads the team and performs hands-on EI&C work and technical mentoring. As we transition towards building at rate, you will take a leading role in standing up a new work center to scale production rates through innovative manufacturing technique development and through automation. You will also lead the team to provide collaborative Design for Manufacturing (DFM) input to the design teams and work to build seamless partnerships across the teams. We are looking for our Manager of Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls Manufacturing to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, analysis, build, and operation of laser, pulsed power, vacuum vessel, and ancillary mechanical systems that are central to Xcimer’s excimer‑laser‑based IFE technology. You will contribute across the full product lifecycle—from early prototype systems through the design and demonstration of a power‑producing inertial fusion reactor. We are seeking engineers who bring strong technical depth, hands‑on problem-solving skills, and a passion for building high‑performance hardware that will redefine the future of energy.

jobs.title: Optical Engineer
jobs.description_text: Xcimer is looking for an Optical Engineer to help us build state-of-the-art UV laser systems for laser driven inertial fusion. We are a small, dynamic, and highly motivated team focused on the most plausible path to bringing fusion to the grid. You will have the opportunity to apply broad optical engineering skills and technical leadership to complex problems, and directly contribute to the design, build, and test of our laser and diagnostic systems. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Production Manager, Wound Film Capacitors
jobs.description_text: This is a full-time, onsite role based at our Tucson, AZ facility. The Production Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and consistent execution of daily manufacturing operations for Xcimer's wound film capacitor production line. This position provides hands-on leadership to machine operators, assemblers, and manufacturing technicians, ensuring production schedules are achieved, employees are properly trained, quality requirements are followed, and manufacturing documentation is accurately maintained. The Production Manager works closely with Production Engineering, Quality Assurance, Maintenance, and Materials Management to resolve production issues and support the transition from pilot manufacturing to higher-volume production. Position Objective Lead daily manufacturing operations to achieve safety, quality, delivery, and productivity objectives through effective workforce management, adherence to established manufacturing procedures, and continuous operational improvement.

jobs.title: Program Planning and Controls (PP&C) Specialist – Directed Energy
jobs.description_text: As a Program Planning and Controls (PP&C) Specialist – Directed Energy, you will play a crucial role in supporting the successful execution of Xcimer’s Directed Energy program. You will work closely with element leads, engineers, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless coordination, tracking, and reporting of project activities. Your ability to manage schedules, maintain project documentation, and facilitate communication will be key to driving efficiency and meeting critical milestones. We are looking for a highly organized individual with strong problem-solving skills, technical fluency, and experience in project tracking, execution, and performance measurement through KPIs and metrics to ensure project success. We are looking for our project coordinators to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Program Planning and Controls Specialist
jobs.description_text: As a Program Planning and Controls Specialist, you will play a crucial role in supporting the successful execution of complex engineering projects on Xcimer’s Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) program. You will work closely with element leads, engineers, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless coordination, tracking, and reporting of project activities. Your ability to manage schedules, maintain project documentation, and facilitate communication will be key to driving efficiency and meeting critical milestones. We are looking for a highly organized individual with strong problem-solving skills, technical fluency, and experience in project tracking, execution, and performance measurement through KPIs and metrics to ensure project success. We are looking for an experienced project controls professional to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description_text: As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will serve as a trusted advisor to managers and leaders across Xcimer, helping build high-performing teams, develop organizational capabilities, and align people strategies with business objectives. You will partner closely with leadership to support talent planning, organizational effectiveness, performance management, employee relations, and change management as we continue to rapidly scale. This role requires a well-rounded HR professional who combines strong HR fundamentals with business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to influence and coach leaders at all levels. You will help managers navigate complex people challenges, identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, and implement programs and initiatives that support employee development, engagement, and organizational growth. We are looking for a proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and is passionate about helping leaders and employees succeed.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Capacitor Production
jobs.description_text: This is a full-time, onsite role based at our Tucson, AZ facility. As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you will own the health of the manufacturing processes running on Xcimer's wound film capacitor line in Tucson, Arizona — the capacitors that store and deliver the energy behind Xcimer's pulsed-power laser drivers. This is a floor-facing process engineering role on a line that is building product today and scaling toward rate. We are looking for an engineer who is relentless about quality, insistent about following process, and energized by making a running line measurably better every week.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter - Science & Research
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Technical Recruiter – Science & Research, you will own full-lifecycle recruiting for Xcimer's Science organization, helping build a world-class team of physicists, scientists, and researchers advancing the future of fusion energy. This role will focus primarily on recruiting PhD-level scientists and highly specialized technical talent across disciplines such as plasma physics, computational physics, theoretical physics, laser physics, fusion science, and other advanced research fields. You will partner closely with scientific leadership to understand complex technical requirements, develop creative sourcing strategies, and identify exceptional talent across national laboratories, research universities, and advanced technology organizations. We are looking for a highly resourceful, intellectually curious recruiter who enjoys solving difficult talent challenges, thrives in niche technical markets, and can build meaningful relationships with some of the world's leading scientific minds. The ideal candidate combines strong sourcing and research capabilities with a consultative approach to recruiting and a passion for helping build teams tackling ambitious scientific challenges.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship - Electrical Engineering
jobs.description_text: Join Xcimer’s engineering internship program and gain hands-on experience in designing and building cutting-edge laser-driven inertial fusion hardware and software. As a summer intern, you will be integral to developing the systems needed for the world’s first commercial fusion energy power plant. We have multiple internship opportunities available across various disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, and Software Development. Please apply to the posting that best matches your background and interests. During this 12-week program at our headquarters in Denver, CO, you’ll work alongside an industry expert mentor to tackle complex, real-world challenges in fields such as structures, mechanisms, optics, pulsed power, computational engineering, plasma physics, and manufacturing. We are seeking interns who are passionate about applying their technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and commitment to quality to drive the future of clean energy! Application close date: 12/31/2026 Undergraduate intern: $25/hr Masters intern: $30/hr PhD intern: $35/hr Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship - Experimental Lasers (Graduate)
jobs.description_text: This is a full-time, onsite 12-week summer internship based at our headquarters in Denver, CO. As an Experimental Lasers Graduate Intern, you will apply your skills to owning a scoped experiment on the pulsed laser systems and diagnostics that support Xcimer's excimer laser development, from first-order model and test plan through measured result. You will be paired with a mentor in the Experimental Lasers group, on a project scoped to your research background. We are looking for our physicists and engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy! FLSA status: Non-Exempt Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship - Experimental Lasers (Undergraduate)
jobs.description_text: This is a full-time, onsite 12-week summer internship based at our headquarters in Denver, CO. As an Experimental Lasers Intern, you will apply your skills to building, aligning, and measuring the pulsed laser systems and diagnostics that support Xcimer's excimer laser development. You will be paired with a mentor in the Experimental Lasers group and work hands-on in the lab, on a project scoped to your background and interests. We are looking for our physicists and engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy! FLSA Status: Non-Exempt Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer IV
jobs.description_text: As a Systems Engineer IV, you will be a thought leader in Xcimer influencing and educating technical leads to capture, organize, and track the integrated technical baseline for our IFE Program. The successful candidate will perform leading and supporting roles in establishing and maintaining bidirectional traceability across our requirements, architecture, documentation, and analysis products. The candidate will define and maintain infrastructure, define relationships between internal and external interfaces, and communicate system-level use cases and relationships to a diverse group of stakeholders. The candidate will work with team leads across the organization to craft the key framework and documents needed to define, design, build, test, and activate our facilities and systems. We are looking for engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - DOE Partnerships
jobs.description_text: As a Technical Project Manager, DOE Partnerships, you will support Xcimer’s public-private partnerships with the U.S. Department of Energy as we design, build, and test the experimental facilities and run the numerical investigations that lead to our fusion pilot plant. You will apply your project management skills to coordinate proposals and milestone reporting, manage cost and schedule performance, and help keep our DOE-funded work on track. As part of the Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) program team, you will work closely with technical leads to translate program requirements into actionable schedules, track progress across concurrent workstreams, and surface risks before they threaten deliverables. We are looking for a project manager who is comfortable coordinating both internal engineering teams and outside consultants to deliver complex technical scope, and who can pick up new technical domains quickly, going deep enough to ask the right questions and spot problems early. In this role, you’ll help manage the partnerships that take Xcimer’s fusion pilot plant from design to reality.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Implosion
jobs.description_text: As a Technical Project Manager – Implosion, you will play a critical role driving execution of the Inertial Fusion Energy Program's Implosion System — the target design, target physics, and ICF implosion systems that enable fusion ignition. You will work closely with the Head of Target Design, the Head of Target Physics Experiments, Program Director, and Project Controls & Planning, as well as the target fabrication, metrology, diagnostics, and chamber-interface teams, to ensure seamless coordination, tracking, and reporting of Implosion System project activities. Your ability to manage schedules, maintain project documentation, design- and experiment-review artifacts and facilitate communication across the Implosion System's and sub-systems will be key to driving efficiency and meeting critical design-review and experimental-campaign milestones. We are looking for a highly organized individual with strong problem-solving skills, technical fluency in target physics, ICF implosion, or high-energy-density hardware systems, and experience in all aspects of engineering and research project delivery. The ideal candidate would have demonstrated experience leading engineering or experimental project execution from cradle to grave in the disciplines of inertial confinement fusion, target design, target fabrication, and/or high-energy-density physics.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager – Laser System
jobs.description_text: As a Technical Project Manager – Laser System, you will play a critical role driving execution of the Inertial Fusion Energy Program’s laser system — the high-energy excimer laser driver systems that will enable nuclear fusion. You will work closely with the Laser System Director, Program Director, and Project Controls & Planning, as well as the optics, pulsed power, laser controls, and beamline engineering teams, to ensure seamless coordination, tracking, and reporting of Laser System project activities. Your ability to manage schedules, maintain project documentation, engineering review artifacts and facilitate communication across the Laser Element’s systems and sub-systems will be key to driving efficiency and meeting critical design-review and build milestones. We are looking for a highly organized individual with strong problem-solving skills, technical fluency in laser/optical or high-energy hardware systems, and experience in all aspects of engineering project delivery. The ideal candidate would have demonstrated experience leading engineering project execution from cradle to grave in the disciplines of photonics, optics, lasers and/or RF.

jobs.title: Vacuum Systems Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Vacuum Systems Mechanical Engineer, you will lead the design, integration, and operation of vacuum systems for rare-gas/halide (excimer) lasers used in IFE power generation. Your work will begin with prototype systems and continue through the design and demonstration of power-producing IFE reactors. You will ensure that vacuum hardware meets flow and performance requirements throughout the product development lifecycle in a dynamic R&D environment. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!
